patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with distinct background colors are used to visually segment content, creating strong visual breaks between topics.
Display headings use an extremely heavy, condensed sans-serif typeface set at very large sizes, creating a bold and impactful visual statement.
A high-contrast, limited color palette dominated by a vibrant yellow and black is used throughout the site, creating a distinctive and modern aesthetic.
The hero section features a large, bold text element that parallax-scrolls upwards and out of view at a faster rate than the background, creating a dynamic reveal of the content below.
Service offerings are presented in an asymmetrical card grid, with two cards aligned on the left and one on the right, each featuring a unique background color.

technique_notes: Sections slide into view from the bottom of the viewport as the user scrolls down, creating a staggered content reveal.

The main hero text element is animated to scroll at a different speed than its background, creating a depth effect as it moves out of view. This could be implemented using scroll-linked transforms, potentially leveraging the detected Lottie for more complex motion.
Each major content section utilizes a distinct, full-width background color to clearly delineate content areas and contribute to the site's bold visual identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy, and condensed display headings (~5-8x body text) create a dominant visual hierarchy, contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently applied to all elements, including buttons, cards, and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between full-bleed sections and within the hero and footer, while content grids maintain a more balanced density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of extremely bold, condensed display typography as a primary visual element, combined with a high-contrast, limited color palette dominated by a vibrant yellow. This creates an almost brutalist yet refined aesthetic that feels both industrial and modern.
